customers.evidence: The Fisher Scientific channel offers customers convenient access to a complete portfolio of laboratory equipment

innovation.evidence: enable customers to push science and technology a step beyond

result.analyst_notes: Confident, aspirational tone opening with a first-person plural quote. Customers and scientific work are addressed first; the page is largely product and brand description. Claims are absolute ('industry leading', 'Recognized for') with no hedging. Innovation and customer access are the most developed themes; employees, DEI, integrity and shareholders are absent.
